_readme: SENTOSA ONLY. The owner's call, 2026-08-16: "All the other districts can throw away. Only sentosa bro." The other sixteen districts and their build outputs are deleted from the tree. They were NEVER part of the live game -- deploy.sh has always stripped them at publish -- so this changes what the repo carries, not what anybody plays. Recoverable from git history.
_origin_note: ONE origin for the whole island, and every district projects from it. Each district used to carry its own, which meant two districts built side by side were each measured from a different zero and would not line up at the seam. Nothing caught it because only one district was ever built. This is the SVY21 datum origin, the point Singapore's own national survey grid is measured from. Coordinates run to tens of thousands of metres across the island; float32 still resolves under 2mm at 30km, and depth precision depends on y, which stays under 200m.

districts.name: Sentosa
districts.notes: BBOX WIDENED 2026-08-03 (was 1.2480,103.8150,1.2620,103.8330): the old box took only the island's northern two-thirds and CUT OFF Sentosa Cove entirely (no W, no Quayside Isle, no ONE°15, no canal houses), the golf clubhouse + driving range, Mount Serapong's summit, Tanjong Beach + Sofitel, and the whole western tip (Fort Siloso, Siloso Point cable car, Mega Adventure) — found by the 2026-08-03 places-research audit, which recommended exactly these bounds. Now the WHOLE island. Original ring-3 notes: Ring 3, two districts out from anything that existed before tonight: it overlaps harbourfront 221x1,558m and nothing else, and harbourfront in turn needed keppel. Both are now built. THE RIDER CAN GET THERE — the road causeway opened in 1992 and cars have been allowed since 1998, so Sentosa Gateway is a real vehicular road and the crossing is a bridge, not a ferry. But the overlap band with harbourfront is mostly WATER, so the seam depends on that bridge deck AND on the coastline reader, which now handles multiple shorelines (this bbox has 27 coastline ways). The box takes the northern two thirds of a ~5 km2 island: Resorts World, Imbiah, Siloso and the Gateway. Siloso, Palawan and Tanjong beaches need the `beach` layer added 2026-08-02 — sand had never been fetched, parsed or coloured anywhere in this pipeline. Brief: research/coastal-expansion.md candidate 7.
districts.noSignals: verified against the local extract 2026-08-02 (node[highway=traffic_signals] in this bbox: 0 elements): Sentosa has no signalised junctions. The island's road network is roundabouts, give-way junctions and the Gateway toll plaza, which is correct for a resort island and is not a failed fetch — the build's own EMPTY warning fired and was checked rather than assumed.
